_notes: Class labels must match the labels used in Teachable Machine.
Dry-run mode prints the mapped action without moving the robot.
Use null for classes that should never move the robot.

red object.description: Pick the fixed pickup object and place it in the red bin.

blue object.description: Pick the fixed pickup object and place it in the blue bin.

empty.description: No object is visible, so the robot should not move.

unknown.description: The model is unsure or the view is bad, so the robot should not move.
